dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I usually don't get a chance to be around this many books unless I'm organizing the Lightkeeper archives.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Let's have a look at this one... Hmm, it's about Liyue's history... The Millelith mentioned here seem to share some similarities with us Lightkeepers...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Sure enough, there will always be those who fight to protect their homeland. We are not alone.
